2608.20281.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
2608.20281.paper_summary: Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering. We propose IAR (Inject, Align, and Recover), a three-stage post-training framework that separates structured document knowledge injection, QA behavior alignment, and general ability recovery. Unlike conventional continued pretraining, Inject converts source documents into continuation, rewrite, and instruction-conditioned reconstruction objectives. Align then adapts the injected model with answer-only QA supervision, while Recover merges the domain-adapted model with the base instruction model to recover general capabilities. Across Common Corpus (CC) and CCI, and across Llama, Phi, Qwen, and SmolLM model families, IAR improves the domain-primary domain-general frontier for retrieval-free document internalization. In the main comparison, IAR improves over Vanilla SFT on all four reported metrics in 7 of 8 dataset-model settings, with average gains of 3.6 percentage points in domain QA accuracy and 12.1 percentage points in mean general performance across IFEval, MMLU, and MSBench. Extended CC baselines show that LoRA and FAPM can win individual general metrics, but among methods that also reach leading or near-leading domain internalization, IAR retains one of the strongest general profiles.
2608.20281.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在推理時未能檢索源文件的情況下，經常無法回答有關有限文檔集合的問題。我們將這種情況研究為文檔知識內部化：將固定的語料庫轉換為可用的參數知識，以便進行無檢索的問題回答。我們提出了IAR（注入、對齊和恢復），這是一個三階段的後訓練框架，將結構化文檔知識注入、QA行為對齊和一般能力恢復分開。與傳統的持續預訓練不同，Inject將源文檔轉換為延續、重寫和指令條件的重建目標。然後，Align使用僅答案的QA監督來調整注入的模型，而Recover則將領域適應的模型與基礎指令模型合併，以恢復一般能力。在Common Corpus (CC)和CCI，以及Llama、Phi、Qwen和SmolLM模型系列中，IAR改善了無檢索文檔內部化的領域主要與領域一般的邊界。在主要比較中，IAR在8個數據集-模型設置中的7個上，在所有四個報告的指標上超越了Vanilla SFT，領域QA準確度的平均增益為3.6個百分點，IFEval、MMLU和MSBench的平均一般性能增益為12.1個百分點。擴展的CC基準顯示，LoRA和FAPM可以在個別一般指標上獲勝，但在也達到領先或接近領先的領域內部化的方法中，IAR保持了最強的一般特徵之一。
